60221.name: Invisibility Device I
60221.SpecificEffects:
At the end of the action, if there are no enemies within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area, gain <buf ID=3004502>[Stealth I]</buf> with a trigger interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

RelatedDescription: This advanced optics system can distort light, allowing ST fitted with this backpack model to become somewhat invisible.
